title: Use a helpful error page
summary: A custom error page explains a missing route while retaining a useful HTTP status.
introduction: A custom error page explains a missing route while retaining a useful HTTP status. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use a helpful error page
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A custom error page explains a missing route while retaining a useful HTTP status.
The configured local 404 page can be used for missing content. internal prevents normal direct external requests to this exact location.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a friendly 404 page with a link back to the home page.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not return a success status for every missing URL.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).

seo.title: Nginx: Use a helpful error page
seo.description: Learn about use a helpful error page in Nginx. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
